summary: The old harness cannot select the supported COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE parsing mode on either side of the change.

assessment.necessity_reason: Parsing XML text is the harness’s primary operation. Both versions support COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE for ordinary text; x y is a finite witness. The harness always constructs a document with the preservation default, and input bytes cannot change that constructor argument.

before.requirement: Parse text containing repeated whitespace with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
before.reason: The old harness uses the default XMLDocument constructor, which selects PRESERVE_WHITESPACE. Its input only supplies XML bytes, so it cannot select the collapsing mode.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: XMLText::ParseDeep enables whitespace collapsing only when the document selects COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
The selected parsing flag causes StrPair to collapse whitespace when text is read.
The selected change group concerns cleanup of parsed child nodes.

after.requirement: Parse text containing repeated whitespace with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected.
after.reason: The mode remains supported, while the same old harness still uses the preservation default.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: XMLText::ParseDeep still enables whitespace collapsing only when the document selects COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
The selected parsing flag still causes StrPair to collapse whitespace when text is read.
The selected change group alters cleanup of parsed child nodes.

assessment.comparison_reason: The supported mode and the harness’s fixed default constructor are unchanged. The cleanup change does not provide an input controlled route to select COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE.
